description: This file is a shell script used for testing custom diff function name patterns in Git, including setup of Git configurations, testing pattern compilations, and verifying diff headers.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting a specific command to complete without errors.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.description: Verifies that a given pattern exists in the output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
